name: Requisition
text: Each player here discards 2 cards or pays 6 credits.

name: Commandeer
text: Each player here discards 2 cards or pays 4 energy.

name: Supply raid
text: Each player with presence here loses 6 credits.

name: Blackout
text: Cities here produce no energy next round; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Sabotage
text: Players here make no energy in upkeep next round and each loses 3 tokens from their cards; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Infiltration
text: 3 adversary ambassadors land on player-owned pieces here (players choose each); the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Agitators
text: 3 adversary ambassadors land on clean cities here (players choose each).

name: Orbital strike
text: An adversary troop lands on a factory here (players choose); with no factory, on a city; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Defection
text: Each player here loses an ambassador (from supply, else from the board); sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Eviction
text: Each player here loses a presence here or pays 6 credits (with one presence on the board, pays).

name: Embargo
text: No site here can be claimed next round; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Smear campaign
text: Each player here gets 2 less insight next round; 2 Sway leaves the Unity bucket.

name: Station seizure
text: A research station here that is not corrupted becomes corrupted (players choose); the adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Overrun
text: The city here that is not corrupted (clean or aligned) with the most adversary ambassadors becomes corrupted (ties: lower hex number).

name: Mass production
text: The adversary builds now, here; the adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Purge protocols
text: Each player discards their most expensive card in hand and loses 3 tokens from their cards.

name: Total war
text: 2 adversary troops land on factories here (else cities), each destroying any presence on its hex, and 2 adversary ambassadors on military bases; the adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Conscription
text: Each player here discards 3 cards or pays 6 energy; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Fifth column
text: 4 adversary ambassadors land on player-owned pieces here (players choose each); the adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Insurrection
text: 4 adversary ambassadors land on clean cities here (players choose each); sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Siege
text: 2 adversary troops land on factories here (players choose; with no factory, on cities), and each player here destroys a presence of theirs here and loses an ambassador (from supply, else from the board); the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Manhunt
text: Each player here destroys a presence of theirs here.
